themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents capable of performing complex research tasks autonomously or with minimal human intervention, often involving decision-making and independent action.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content discussing AI tools that help developers write, debug, review, and manage code, acting as intelligent partners in the software development lifecycle.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles that review, compare, or introduce specific AI-powered platforms and software designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, aiding comprehension and information retrieval.

themes.name: AI research platforms
themes.description: Articles about comprehensive platforms that leverage AI to support diverse research activities, from data analysis to hypothesis generation.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Content related to AI applications used for designing, distributing, analyzing, or optimizing surveys and questionnaires.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Articles detailing how AI is used to automate, enhance, or analyze user experience testing processes.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Discusses the intersection of AI and design methodologies, focusing on how AI influences the design process and research practices within it.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Covers AI tools and techniques used for creating various forms of content, including text, code, and other media.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that directly compare and contrast different AI-powered tools designed for research purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
